connected_flows.limitations: Reset is native; remaining main-loop callees use original ARM execution in the verification harness. Not complete native driver recovery.

commands.limitations: Types 1/3/4 use separate note/control/bank-selection suites. Other main-loop services and physical sound synthesis remain separate.

bank_selection.classification: Complete command subpath, not a separately identified complete function
bank_selection.limitations: Unicorn reference is explicitly corrected for documented pre-ARMv6 unaligned word accesses; missing MASARU bank path retains its original -1 pointer and wrapped low-RAM reads. No hardware timing, synthesis or playback proof.

controls.classification: Complete type-3 command subpath, not a separately identified complete function
controls.limitations: Original type-1 note commands are used only to prepare input voice fixtures, not inside native control runs. Modeled MMIO, active SVC state, no sound synthesis/hardware timing/playback claim.

notes.classification: All eight command types execute in native C, with no ARM callback in supported command runs
notes.limitations: Remaining main-loop, interrupt/timing and sound-chip synthesis work is separate.

status.classification: Both status routines connected in both drivers; reset and 16 main-loop fixtures compared separately

pending_update.classification: Pending update, descriptor upload and reset-helper calls execute in native C for both drivers

snapshot.classification: Three snapshot loops execute natively for both drivers

ramps.classification: Counter/ramps connected; repeated ramps/snapshot flow matches original ARM with no fallback callback

effects.classification: Ten-call original main-loop update segment executes natively; five effect routines per driver connected

stream_update.classification: 24-stream update and direct helpers connected; repeated stream/effects original-site flow with explicit sequencer gap

sequencer.classification: Sequencer connected; contiguous stream/sequencer/channel segment without skipped calls in that segment

interrupt_input_main.classification: Shared main DLL and RAM across explicit FIQ event entry, input parsing, timer flags, command-ring production/consumption and complete main iterations. CPU/CPSR/banks/RAM/MMIO/ordered effects match original ARM. Independently checked volume/pan state, interrupted registers, 32-interrupt counter wrap and three full-tick iterations per fixture. No automatic host interrupt scheduler, physical timing, synthesis, all command families or complete-game proof; no new complete-routine credit.
